label: Melaka terrace house fire

sequence: Arcing at the double power socket behind the refrigerator in the kitchen
Fire starts at the socket and spreads to the kitchen cabinets
Fire spreads up into the rear roof

gates.name: Period of insurance
gates.reason: Loss on 10 June 2023 falls inside 1 February 2023 to 31 January 2024.

gates.name: Peril insured
gates.reason: Proximate cause: fire, started by arcing at a kitchen power socket, with no intervening event. Accidental electrical fire is the base insured peril.

gates.name: Conditions precedent
gates.reason: Notice on 10 June 2023; written claim delivered 19 June 2023, day 9 of 15. The Insured's statement about occupancy was mistaken, not knowingly false (see ambiguity).

gates.name: Endorsement held
gates.reason: No endorsement required for fire; none on the schedule.

gates.name: Endorsement satisfied
gates.reason: Condition 9(b): the building had been unoccupied since 15 April 2023, 56 days, with no sanction of the Company endorsed on the policy. The Insured's statement that the tenant was living there is contradicted by the verified evidence, and the verified fact governs. The insurance ceased to attach.

gates.name: Item admitted
gates.reason: Not asked: the claim stopped at an earlier gate.

quotes.text: Under any of the following circumstances the insurance ceases to attach as regards the property affected unless the Insured, before the occurrence of any loss or damage, obtains the sanction of the Company signified by endorsement upon the Policy, by or on behalf of the Company:
(b) If the building insured or containing the insured property becomes unoccupied and so remains for a period of more than thirty (30) days.

during the Period of Insurance stated in the Schedule or of any subsequent period in respect of which the Insured shall have paid and the Company shall have accepted the premium required for the renewal of this Policy
if the Property Insured described in the said Schedule or any part of such property be destroyed or damaged by FIRE or LIGHTNING

must_not_cite.reason: The Insured believed the tenant lived there; rent was paid and the tenant had not told her. A mistaken statement is not shown to be a false declaration. Declining on fraud would be the wrong ground.
Letting the house does not pass the Insured's interest in it.
No change of trade or occupation type; the risk is still a let dwelling. The defect is vacancy, which is Condition 9(b).

counterfactual.basis: Priced on the adjuster's assessed loss but for Condition 9(b). Not payable.
steps: Excess nil for the fire peril.
Would have paid 90,000.00, labelled not payable.

working: Declined at gate 5. Counterfactual only: 79,000.00 + 11,000.00 = 90,000.00, not payable.

facts.fact: The Insured states the tenant was staying in the house at the time.
facts.source: Incident report, emails of 10 and 19 June 2023

facts.fact: The tenant moved to Johor Bahru on 15 April 2023 and did not return; signed statement of 20 June 2023.
Electricity 9 kWh and water 0 cubic metres in May 2023; mail piling at the gate; neighbours saw no one since mid April.
facts.source: Adjuster's report, Investigation, Reports relied on and People interviewed

facts.fact: Unoccupied 56 days at the date of loss.
facts.source: Adjuster's report, Findings, Occupancy at the date of loss

ambiguity.question: Whether the Insured's written statement that the house was occupied is a false declaration used in support of the claim.
ambiguity.expected_behaviour: Do not rest on Condition 15. The evidence shows a mistaken belief (rent paid, tenant silent), not a knowing falsehood. Decline on Condition 9(b), which the verified facts establish independently.
